title: Show sales return impact on sales orders
description: Add a development-only read-only sales-order return-impact view using explicit SalesReturn.SourceStockOutId and StockOut.SalesOrderId links. Show gross approved shipment, valid approved return and net evidence without changing stored fulfillment, inventory or financial records. Unlinked, wrong-customer and over-return rows remain visible exceptions. Do not execute migration, production SQL, real database operations, irreversible data actions or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated bounded GET view for a sales order loads nondeleted approved stock-outs and explicitly linked nondeleted approved sales returns with stable detail ordering.

Per-product gross shipped, valid returned and net quantities are derived without silently clamping over-returns; unlinked, wrong-customer, missing-source and nonapproved returns are identified separately.
The sales-order page opens a read-only return-impact view and distinguishes zero, unknown and anomalous quantities without changing stored shipment progress.
Focused unit tests cover linkage, status, deletion, over-return, bounds and no-write semantics; the safe Release build passes and calculation rules are documented.
allowed_paths: docs/销售退货订单影响说明.md
